verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS product with a public REST API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Trello offering a sandbox, test-mode, or isolated non-production environment. The docs say an API key plus token 'can be used to read and write for your entire Trello account,' and running a custom Power-Up 'on one of your Trello boards' is a developer workaround, not product-provided sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
